title: Black Lotus: A New Harbor Mystery
art_style: Print Comic Noir Style (halftone dots, bold outlines, gritty rain-slicked urban environments, dramatic lighting, desaturated blues and golds, exaggerated silhouettes)
short_summary: In rain-soaked New Harbor, detective Jack unravels a web of betrayal and regret. Each clue and confession is fair-play, the city itself a character. As the case closes, hope flickers in the spaces between shadows.
world_context: A noir-inspired, mid-20th-century American city. New Harbor is a place of perpetual rain, neon-lit alleys, jazz clubs, and lingering secrets. The city is both setting and character, its atmosphere saturated with smoke, regret, and fleeting hope.

characters.name: Jack
characters.physical_traits: Lean build, angular face, sharp blue eyes, perpetual five o'clock shadow, short dark hair often tousled by rain
quirks: Listens for distant jazz to calm his nerves
characters.typical_attire: Dark trenchcoat, rumpled suit, loosened tie, scuffed leather shoes, fedora (often rain-soaked)
characters.backstory: A once-idealistic detective hardened by years of disappointment and betrayal. Jack has lost friends and lovers to the city's darkness, but still clings to a stubborn sense of justice.
characters.motivations: Haunted by past failures, Jack seeks redemption through his cases. He wants to believe the city—and himself—can be saved, even if only a little.

chapters.chapter_summary: Dawn breaks over New Harbor. Jack closes his notebook, reflecting on the city's scars and the faint hope that remains. The Black Lotus sign glows in the mist, and a new song rises in the distance. The case is over, but the city—and Jack—are changed.

scenes.location: New Harbor – Alley outside the Black Lotus
scenes.scene_description: Night recedes as the city transitions from darkness to the first hints of dawn. The Black Lotus sign glows faintly in the mist.

panels.location: New Harbor – Alley outside the Black Lotus
panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Establishing shot of New Harbor's rain-slicked alley at pre-dawn. The Black Lotus neon sign glows dimly through the mist, its red letters reflected in puddles. Trash bins and brick walls frame the scene. The city skyline is a silhouette against the fading night. Desaturated blues and golds, halftone texture, dramatic shadows. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Night recedes, city transitions to dawn.

dialogue.text: Night receded from New Harbor’s alleys.

panels.location: New Harbor – Alley outside the Black Lotus
panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot of the Black Lotus sign above a closed club door, its neon glow flickering. The rain has stopped, but the pavement is still wet. A faint haze lingers in the air, and a distant streetlamp casts a golden pool of light. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Black Lotus sign glows faintly, city quiet.

dialogue.text: The Black Lotus sign glowed faintly, a memory more than a beacon.

pages.page_description: Dawn breaks over the city, the Black Lotus sign glows in the mist.

scenes.location: New Harbor – Rooftop overlooking the city
scenes.scene_description: Jack stands on a rooftop, closing his notebook and taking in the city as the first light touches the skyline.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot from a rooftop, looking down at the city. Rooftops glisten with rain, and the Black Lotus sign is visible in the distance. The sky is pale, streaked with the first hints of sunrise. Jack stands at the edge, his silhouette framed against the awakening city. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack surveys the city from above.

dialogue.text: Jack closed his notebook, listening to the city’s breath.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of Jack, trenchcoat collar up, closing his battered notebook. His face is tired but resolute, breath visible in the morning chill. The city skyline blurs behind him. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand holding the battered notebook, rain droplets on the cover. His fingers are tense, knuckles pale. The city lights blur in the background. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: The past could never be erased—

pages.page_description: Jack reflects on the city and his own scars as dawn breaks.

scenes.location: New Harbor – Empty street near the Black Lotus
scenes.scene_description: A new day begins. The city is quiet, but a distant jazz melody rises, hinting at hope.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot of an empty street, wet pavement reflecting the pale morning light. The Black Lotus sign is barely visible at the far end. A faint, ghostly musical note drifts through the air, suggesting a jazz melody. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: A new song begins in the distance.

dialogue.text: In the distance, a new song began.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of Jack walking away from the Black Lotus, hands in pockets, shoulders slightly hunched. The city is waking up behind him, but he moves forward into the light. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack walks away from the Black Lotus, toward the dawn.

dialogue.text: Maybe, in the spaces between betrayals, something like hope could take root.

pages.page_description: A new day begins as Jack walks away from the Black Lotus.

scenes.location: New Harbor – Fade to city skyline
scenes.scene_description: The city skyline in morning light. The case is over, but the city—and Jack—are changed. The story ends.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot of New Harbor’s skyline in the soft morning light. The rain has stopped, and the city glows with a fragile warmth. The Black Lotus sign is just visible among the rooftops. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: The city stands in the morning light.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of the Black Lotus neon sign, now turned off, its letters outlined against the brightening sky. Dew clings to the glass. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Black Lotus sign in morning silence.

pages.page_description: The city in morning light; the Black Lotus sign fades into memory.
